instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/frame_blank.step in BRL-CAD. Cut a centered 110 x 60 mm through window from the plate to form a rectangular frame. Add one 12 x 12 x 20 mm post at each of the four outside corners, with post bottom faces aligned to the original plate bottom face. Cut one through hole of diameter 4 mm through the center of each post. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl. [Software] Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH). For this task, BRL-CAD's main editor is `/usr/brlcad/bin/mged`; its conversion and rendering tools are under the same `/usr/brlcad/bin` directory when working on `frame_blank.step`.
